name: What are some popular luxury features to include in a custom shower design?

mainEntity.name: What are some popular luxury features to include in a custom shower design?

acceptedAnswer.text: Popular luxury features to include in a custom shower design often focus on creating a truly spa-inspired experience. These can encompass large format tile, rainfall showerheads, body jets, steam shower capabilities, heated flooring, integrated seating or benches, and smart shower controls. Frameless glass enclosures contribute to a sleek, expansive feel, while thoughtful lighting design enhances ambiance and functionality. AKN Design Group works with homeowners to select features that align with their lifestyle and aesthetic preferences, ensuring the customized renovation enhances daily routines and provides a high-end retreat within their home. We prioritize features that elevate both beauty and usability.
acceptedAnswer.description: Popular luxury custom shower features include rainfall showerheads, body jets, steam capabilities, heated floors, integrated seating, and smart controls, all contributing to a spa-inspired experience tailored to your lifestyle.
